scenes.title: Stories of Childhood
scenes.rationale: The personal histories form a distinct opening conversation before attention turns to the party’s current problems.
scenes.overview: Share memories of family, childhood, and home.
scenes.transitionToNext: The conversation turns to the party’s unresolved mysteries.

scenes.title: Mysteries and Recovered Magic
scenes.rationale: Comparing the journal and tower clues leads into experiments with the recovered objects, all within the same morning investigation.
scenes.overview: Compare clues about Hralgar and Agata, then test the mirror and goggles.
scenes.transitionToNext: The party leaves camp and encounters gnolls.

scenes.title: South Across the Plains
scenes.rationale: The gnoll encounter and its aftermath lead into the brief continuation of the same southward journey, ending at the roadside camp near Karawa.
scenes.overview: Defeat the gnolls, recover, and travel south while mapping ley lines.
scenes.transitionToNext: At the roadside camp, the party returns to its magical investigation.

scenes.title: The Ivory Scroll’s Past
scenes.rationale: The mirror vision and its interpretation form one continuous investigation of the scroll and planar corruption; the table break does not create an in-world scene.
scenes.overview: Identify the mirror, witness the scroll’s creation, and discuss planar magic and corruption.
scenes.transitionToNext: The next morning brings the final approach to Karawa.

scenes.title: Karawa After the Siege
scenes.rationale: Arrival, the ruined town, and Candrosa’s siege account form one focused homecoming before Alesh’s southern intelligence.
scenes.overview: Survey the damage, greet Havdar, and hear how the centaurs relieved the temple.
scenes.transitionToNext: Alesh begins reporting on her southern scouting journey.

scenes.title: News from the Southern Frontier
scenes.rationale: Alesh’s linked scouting reports and the questions they prompt about Shakun’s defenses and Agata form one sustained investigation.
scenes.overview: Trace gnoll movements and fading defenses; hear about the raven, empty house, orc scouts, and Old Woman of the Dusts.
